notes: Signing in replaces the gateway key. On the connect step you now sign in with your Alton account and VDR Workbench sets up its own connection: it fetches the key issued to you and keeps it encrypted under your Windows profile, so there is nothing to find, paste or keep track of. If your key is ever changed centrally, the app picks up the new one by itself. Settings is simpler as a result. The Gateway connection card shows the account you are signed in as, with a sign out beside it, and the gateway address and API key are no longer shown at all. A key can still be entered by hand under Developer, for a computer where signing in cannot work. The connect step now confirms who you are signed in as and waits for you to continue rather than moving on by itself, you can switch to a different account from there, and the converter step is always shown rather than skipped when a converter is already installed.
